assets.name: closed-eyes
assets.mapping: Resize to 850x650 before local alignment; full portrait origin is (300,320). Generated geometry is approximate, so align eye patches locally.
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: one closed-eyelid animation source frame for an existing 2D portrait.
Input image: Image 1 is the exact edit target, an 850 × 650 crop of Alice Kuonji's head.
Primary request: Change ONLY her two eyes from open to fully closed, neutral and relaxed eyelids, as at the closed midpoint of a natural blink.
Constraints: Keep the exact original canvas, framing, scale, head angle, facial perspective, face outline, nose, unsmiling mouth, neutral expression, neck, white hat and bow, every hair strand and fringe, clothing, skin palette, shading, lighting, sharp anime linework, and original illustration style unchanged. Preserve the precise eye placement and asymmetry implied by the perspective. Replace all visible irises, pupils, sclera and eye highlights with matching skin and a fine closed-lid lash contour at each original eye position. Closed eyes must be fully shut, relaxed and natural, without smiling arcs or squinting; do not raise the cheeks or eyebrows. Keep the hair overlapping the eyes unchanged. This is a tiny localized edit, not a redraw.
Scene/backdrop: Preserve genuinely transparent pixels outside the character, with real alpha transparency; no black or checkerboard background.
Avoid: any open eye sliver, new pose, new smile, changed nose or mouth, changed face shape, different hat or hair, extra details, crop, zoom, repositioning, border, text, watermark.
Output: Exactly one edited image, maintaining the 850 × 650 composition.

assets.name: torso-backing
assets.mapping: Resize to 850x1200 before local alignment; full portrait origin is (300,0). Generated backing top roughly matches original y~850.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: hidden clean backing texture for layered animation of an existing anime portrait.
Input image: Image 1 is the exact edit target, an 850 × 1200 head-and-upper-torso crop.
Primary request: Remove the entire head, face, exposed skin, white hat, white bow, and all black hair. Leave only the existing black turtleneck and white coat in their EXACT original canvas positions. Reconstruct the small missing black collar/neck fabric and white coat areas that were hidden by the lower hair tips, with matching local linework, color, folds, shading and edge continuity.
Composition/framing: Preserve the input 850 × 1200 composition and torso coordinates exactly. The remaining torso occupies only the bottom portion of the canvas, starting around y=840. Everything above the neckline should be completely transparent. Preserve the original coat's asymmetrical perspective and all visible garment folds. Do not center, move, enlarge, zoom, or reframe the torso.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine fully transparent alpha background, including the entire removed head region and all empty space. Do not paint a checkerboard or opaque background; actual transparent pixels are required.
Style/medium: Preserve the original sharp anime illustration style.
Constraints: The visible coat and black turtleneck already present must remain unchanged. Fill only occluded garment regions previously behind the hair and head. Keep the white coat silhouette at the image's lower edge unchanged. End at a natural black turtleneck collar top at its original height, without exposed skin, a head, a neck stump, an interior cavity, a hanger or a mannequin. No changes to pose or perspective.
Avoid: residual hair strands, face parts, hat parts, bow parts, body relocation, new accessories, text, watermarks, checkerboard pattern, solid background.
Output: Exactly one edited image, 850 × 1200 composition with transparent upper space and garment anchored at its original lower-canvas coordinates.

warning: Both outputs contain baked checkerboard backgrounds despite explicit genuine-alpha prompts. Do not treat the full output as a transparent cutout. Use only required inner eye/garment pixels and own rig masks. No retries were performed.
